svg.title: Nous
svg.desc: Provenance. The master mark of the Nous dashboard and companion icons: the capital N of Archivo Bold (Archivo v2.001, wght 700, wdth 100, the static instance Google Fonts serves for https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@100,700, file https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3k6o8UDI-1M0wlSV9XAw6lQkqWY8Q82sJaRE-NWIDdgffTT0zRp8A.ttf; SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2020 The Archivo Project Authors, https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Archivo), outlined with fontTools 4.68.0 SVGPathPen in font units (1000 per em, y up, glyph box 76 0 678 686), in #eef2f3 (chart paper) on a #12304f (Atlantic blue) plate with 96 px corners, the N 56% of the plate high, centred. No generated imagery. Brief: PRODUCT.md and .impeccable/surfaces/dashboard-app.md (own world: chart paper, Atlantic blue; plain words, no invented symbol). The PNGs are rendered from this file by render-icons.mjs.
